{{Top|canon=The Journals of Ben Kenobi}}
[[File:Obi-Wans_Journal_CCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The book in Kenobi's hut]]
'''Obi-Wan's Journal'''<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|cardname=Obi-Wan's Journal}}</ref> was a tome found by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|Ben Kenobi's hut]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. It was left by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] for Luke Skywalker and contained enormous amount of information useful for the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including the plans for building a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as well as instructions for building the required tools to do so. Skywalker made use of it to contruct [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|his own lightsaber]].

The volume the book was being kept in, was locked by a thumbprint clasp, that could be opened by Skywalker's thumbprint only and was rigged with a flashpacket to burst into flames had anyone else tried to open it.<ref name="The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>
